description: Close a deliberation and compute its outcome from the votes cast under its rule. Closing is final: further comments and votes are refused with -32032. Calling it again on a closed deliberation returns the same outcome and changes nothing, so a retry is safe. Votes never cast are simply absent from the tally rather than counted as abstentions.

deliberation_id.description: Identifier returned by chap.deliberate.open. Closing computes the outcome from the votes cast; closing an already closed deliberation returns the outcome unchanged.

name: chap.deliberate.close
title: Close deliberation
